question: For each department, give the department name and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for reserved library materials, considering only terms that are regular terms and only for the Mathematics department (Course 18). Do not return any rounded answers.

    lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS COEFFICIENT_OF_VARIATION
FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at
  ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso
  ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID
  AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE
WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'
  AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '18'
GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
